category_title: Latino/a students with externalizing behaviors who retaliate physically to racial microaggressions
minimal_context: The student is participating in independent work time in the classroom and is asked to turn in a homework assignment.
dialogue:
TUTOR: It is time for independent work. Please take out your homework assignment from yesterday so I can collect it.

STUDENT: I don't have it done. I need a couple of more days to do it.

TUTOR: The deadline for the homework is today.

STUDENT: Why are you being so hard on me? I'm trying to tell you why my homework is late.

TUTOR: You need to complete your assignments on time.

STUDENT: You're not understanding at all. I'm not doing this right now. (Pushes the assignment away and starts goofing off)

options.A: Proactively contact parents (using a translator if needed) to share both successes and concerns regarding the student's assignments.
options.B: Structure the classroom using cooperative learning as an alternative strategy for completing homework assignments during independent work time.
options.C: Require the student's completed homework assignments to be shared with the rest of the class on the large screen.
options.D: Teach the student to use appointment cards to access peer attention during independent work time, using a checklist of choices.
